title: Startup Landing Page
briefText: Need a responsive marketing landing page for a SaaS waitlist. Must include hero, pricing teaser, and email capture. Timeline: 2 weeks.

title: Agency Portfolio Redesign
briefText: Redesign our creative agency portfolio site. Keep existing content, modernize UI, add case-study pages. Timeline: 3 weeks.

title: Small E-commerce MVP
briefText: Build an MVP storefront with product listing, cart, and Stripe checkout. Inventory under 50 SKUs. Timeline: 4 weeks.

title: Internal Admin Dashboard
briefText: React admin dashboard for order tracking with charts, filters, and CSV export. Auth already exists. Timeline: 3 weeks.

title: Third-party API Integration
briefText: Integrate Shopify + HubSpot into our Node backend. Need webhooks, retries, and logging. Timeline: 2 weeks.

title: Legacy Site Mobile Fix
briefText: Make our 2018 marketing site fully responsive without rewriting the CMS. Fix critical mobile bugs. Timeline: 10 days.

title: Auth & Roles Overhaul
briefText: Replace session cookies with JWT + OAuth (Google). Add role-based access for admin/editor. Timeline: 3 weeks.

title: Real-time Support Chat Widget
briefText: Embeddable chat widget with WebSockets, agent inbox, and basic analytics. Timeline: 4 weeks.

title: REST to GraphQL Migration
briefText: Expose our existing REST data via GraphQL for a new React client. Keep REST for legacy. Timeline: 5 weeks.

title: Test Suite for React App
briefText: Add Jest + React Testing Library coverage for critical flows; aim 70% on key modules. Timeline: 2 weeks.

title: Dockerize MERN App
briefText: Containerize frontend, API, and Mongo with docker-compose for staging. Document deploy steps. Timeline: 1 week.

title: Frontend Performance Pass
briefText: Audit and improve Lighthouse scores on our Next.js site: images, bundle size, caching. Timeline: 10 days.
